featured_reviews.review_text:
It’s been over a month since I got my S5 Sportback from Audi Mumbai West, and I must say that the experience has been truly outstanding! My conversation with Ashif was 100% over WhatsApp calls, as I decided on my car purchase while being in Germany. Ashif was very kind and patient in answering all my questions, and most importantly, very guiding throughout. He was prompt in explaining all available options for vehicle PPF, insurance, and accessories, and also ended up suggesting what was the best option. Expensive options are not always the best choices and sometimes do not fit your individual tastes, and he made sure this was taken into account. It is rare that you actually have a sales consultant thinking like a customer and making sure the right choices are made!

The whole team was also very diligent in taking care of end-to-end processes. They made sure I was aware of the progress every single step of the way — through photos, calls, and WhatsApp updates. Hats off to their service attitude!

featured_reviews.review_text:

And then during the last day when my I signed my loan agreement and everything got finalised, i found out that they had already sold the car to some other dealer. They even deducted ₹5000 from the token amount and refunded just ₹10,000.
The staff is very rude. They don’t care about their customers but only about their own profit. They don’t even have the full knowledge of the cars they’re selling. There are many other better dealers and showrooms who are not a fraud like them.
